---
title: "Best LMB Starting Pitchers vs. Left-Handed Batters"
subtitle: "2026 Season · Minimum 57 IP overall · Top 20, sorted by BAA vs LHB"
format:
  html:
    echo: false
---

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| message: false
#| warning: false

library(tidyverse)
library(gt)

format_ip <- function(outs) {
  innings <- floor(outs / 3)
  remainder <- outs %% 3
  return(as.numeric(paste0(innings, ".", remainder)))
}
# Place vs_lhb.csv in this same project folder (or adjust the path below)
raw <- read_csv("vs_lhb.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
raw <- raw %>%
  mutate(
    IP = format_ip(Outs))
```

```{r}
#| label: prep-data
#| message: false
#| warning: false

# ---- Qualified starters (SP) with >= 52 IP overall ------------------------
overall <- raw %>%
  filter(split_type == "Overall", role == "SP") %>%
  filter(IP >= 57) %>%
  transmute(
    pitcher_id, Name, Team, pitch_hand, age, birth_country,
    GS, IP_ov = IP, W, L, ERA_ov = ERA, WHIP_ov = WHIP,
    BAA_ov = BAA, `K%_ov` = `K%`, `BB%_ov` = `BB%`, HR9_ov = `HR/9`
  )

# ---- vs_LHB split for those same pitchers ---------------------------------
vs_lhb <- raw %>%
  filter(split_type == "vs_LHB", pitcher_id %in% overall$pitcher_id) %>%
  transmute(
    pitcher_id, IP_lhb = IP, BAA_lhb = BAA,
    `K%_lhb` = `K%`, `BB%_lhb` = `BB%`, HR9_lhb = `HR/9`,
    `GO%_lhb` = `GO%`, `AO%_lhb` = `AO%`, Whiff_lhb = `Whiff%`
  )

# ---- Join, rank (best vs LHB = lowest BAA, then highest K%), top 10 -------
tbl <- overall %>%
  inner_join(vs_lhb, by = "pitcher_id") %>%
  arrange(BAA_lhb, desc(`K%_lhb`)) %>%
  select(-c(pitcher_id,BAA_ov,HR9_ov,`GO%_lhb`,`AO%_lhb`)) %>%
  mutate(Rank = row_number(), .before = Name) %>%
  slice_head(n = 20)
```

```{r}
#| label: gt-table
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false

tbl %>%
  gt() %>%
  tab_header(
    title = "Best LMB Starting Pitchers vs. Left-Handed Batters",
    subtitle = "2026 Season · Minimum 57 IP overall · Top 10, sorted by BAA vs LHB"
  ) %>%
  tab_spanner(label = "Pitcher Info", columns = c(Rank, Name, Team, pitch_hand, age, birth_country)) %>%
  tab_spanner(label = "Overall", columns = c(GS, IP_ov, W, L, ERA_ov, WHIP_ov, `K%_ov`, `BB%_ov`)) %>%
  tab_spanner(label = "vs LHB", columns = c(IP_lhb, BAA_lhb, `K%_lhb`, `BB%_lhb`, HR9_lhb, Whiff_lhb)) %>%
  cols_label(
    Rank = "Rank", Name = "Name", Team = "Team", pitch_hand = "Throws", age = "Age", birth_country = "Country",
    GS = "GS", IP_ov = "IP", W = "W", L = "L", ERA_ov = "ERA", WHIP_ov = "WHIP",
    #BAA_ov = "BAA", 
    `K%_ov` = "K%", `BB%_ov` = "BB%", 
    #HR9_ov = "HR/9",
    IP_lhb = "IP", BAA_lhb = "BAA", `K%_lhb` = "K%", `BB%_lhb` = "BB%",
    HR9_lhb = "HR/9", 
    #`GO%_lhb` = "GO%", `AO%_lhb` = "AO%",
    Whiff_lhb = "Whiff%"
  ) %>%
  fmt_number(columns = c(IP_ov, IP_lhb), decimals = 1) %>%
  fmt_number(columns = c(ERA_ov, WHIP_ov), decimals = 2) %>%
  fmt_number(columns = c(BAA_lhb), decimals = 3) %>%
  fmt_percent(columns = c(`K%_ov`, `BB%_ov`, `K%_lhb`, `BB%_lhb`, Whiff_lhb),
              scale_values = FALSE, decimals = 1) %>%
  fmt_number(columns = c(HR9_lhb), decimals = 2) %>%
  cols_align(align = "center", columns = -c(Name, Team, birth_country)) %>%
  tab_style(
    style = cell_text(weight = "bold"),
    locations = cells_column_spanners(everything())
  ) %>%
  tab_style(
    style = cell_text(weight = "bold"),
    locations = cells_body(columns = Rank)
  ) %>%
  tab_source_note(source_note = "") %>%
  opt_table_font(font = google_font("Roboto")) %>%
  opt_row_striping() %>%
  tab_options(
    table.width = pct(100),
    table.font.size = px(12),
    data_row.padding = px(4),
    column_labels.padding = px(4),
    heading.title.font.size = px(18),
    heading.subtitle.font.size = px(12),
    table.layout = "fixed"
  ) %>%
  cols_width(
    Rank ~ px(40),
    Name ~ px(200),
    Team ~ px(40),
    pitch_hand ~ px(40),
    age ~ px(40),
    birth_country ~ px(50),
    everything() ~ px(40)
  )
```
